text: Yes, I do, although I don't read as much as I used to. When I was at school I'd get through a novel every week, but these days I mostly read articles online. I'm trying to get back into it by reading for twenty minutes before bed.

tips.en: Used to and would show how the habit has changed.
tips.kk: Used to және would әдеттің қалай өзгергенін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Used to и would показывают, как изменилась привычка.
tips.example: I don't read as much as I used to

tips.en: The answer ends with a concrete step, not a complaint.
tips.kk: Жауап шағыммен емес, нақты қадаммен аяқталады.
tips.ru: Ответ заканчивается конкретным шагом, а не жалобой.
tips.example: by reading for twenty minutes before bed

questions.followUp: What was the last book you read?
questions.question: Do you like reading?

text: I'm really into crime novels and thrillers, because I love trying to work out the ending before the detective does. Every now and then I also read biographies of business people, which I find quite inspiring, even if some of them are a bit too positive about their own success.

tips.en: The speaker explains exactly why the genre appeals.
tips.ru: Автор объясняет, чем именно нравится жанр.
tips.example: because I love trying to work out the ending

tips.en: Even if adds an honest opinion, so the answer does not sound memorised.
tips.kk: Even if шынайы бағаны қосады — жауап жатталған болып естілмейді.
tips.ru: Even if добавляет честную оценку — ответ не звучит заученно.
tips.example: even if some of them are a bit too positive

questions.followUp: Do you have a favourite writer?
questions.question: What kind of books do you enjoy?

text: For novels I definitely prefer paper books. There's something about holding a real book and turning the pages that helps me concentrate. That said, e-books are much more practical when I'm travelling, since I can carry hundreds of them on one device.

tips.en: That said shows when the choice changes.
tips.kk: That said таңдау қашан өзгеретінін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: That said показывает, когда выбор меняется.
tips.example: That said, e-books are much more practical

tips.en: Describing the physical experience makes the reason personal.
tips.example: holding a real book and turning the pages

note.en: Introduces a feeling that is hard to explain.

questions.question: Do you prefer paper books or e-books?

text: I did, mainly thanks to my mum, who took me to the library every Saturday. I especially loved adventure stories, and I remember reading one series so many times that the covers eventually fell off. Those books probably did more for my imagination than anything else.

tips.en: Thanks to explains where the habit came from.
The detail about the covers brings the memory to life.
tips.kk: Мұқаба туралы дерек естелікті тірі етеді.
tips.ru: Деталь про обложки делает воспоминание живым.

note.en: A natural way to start a memory.

questions.question: Did you read a lot as a child?

text: In a way, yes. People probably read fewer books than before, mostly because phones and streaming take up so much free time. On the other hand, we read constantly online — messages, news, posts — so it's not that people have stopped reading, it's that the kind of reading has changed.

tips.en: The speaker separates reading books from reading in general — a mature answer.
tips.kk: Автор «кітап оқу» мен «жалпы оқуды» ажыратады — парасатты жауап.
tips.ru: Автор различает «читать книги» и «читать вообще» — зрелый ответ.
tips.example: it's not that people have stopped reading

tips.en: On the other hand balances the answer.
tips.kk: On the other hand жауапты теңестіреді.
tips.ru: On the other hand балансирует ответ.
tips.example: On the other hand, we read constantly online

note.en: A phrasal verb: use up time.

questions.question: Do you think people read less these days?
